text:
maria: Heads-up: Acme wants an air-gapped POC next month. Need clarity on packaging, signed bundles, upgrade cadence, and legal telemetry opt-out. cc @josh @anika
josh: Thanks. Do they require USB/physical media or will scp over jumpbox be ok?
customer-tech: We prefer USB due to no egress policy. Also need offline license activation via entitlement file.
anika: Legal: telemetry must be off by default, and we need an SLA for critical patches. Also they want image signing provenance.
lee: We can provide signed minibundles + delta patches. Upgrade cadence: monthly security patches + quarterly feature bundles. For airgap we support full-image and delta via signed manifests.
josh: Options for delivery: USB with HSM-wrapped PGP signature, or rsync over a pre-signed tarball with checksum. For activation: `redwoodctl activate --license-file <file>` the offline flow exists.
customer-tech: What about KMS/HSM integration? We can't call external KMS.
anika: We can provide on-prem KMS integration if customer exposes internal KMS endpoints; otherwise offline licensing with HSM-backed signing is acceptable.
lee: Note: quantized model bundles are larger; delta patches may not be possible across quant configs. Need to lock quantization in POC.
maria: Pricing ask: POC discount? Also clarity on Dedicated -> Private migration path and cost for onprem deployment.
josh: Standard POC discount applies; migration needs one-time migration fee + monthly license. I'll loop in account exec.
deploy-bot: Checklist created: 1) signed bundle build, 2) offline activation script, 3) USB manifest, 4) test plan. Link: https://internal/redwood/poc/1716543210
anika: Next steps: draft runbook for shipping & activation + security questionnaire answers. @maria can you run SOW and legal questions?
maria: On it. I'll add estimated ship dates (ETA 4 weeks for first USB), will confirm pricing and SOW by EOD Friday. :thumbsup:
